verdict.rationale: Lorikeet provides several bulk-oriented capabilities relevant to an AI-native user: running simulation batches across hundreds of scenarios with side-by-side comparisons, auditing entire knowledge bases at scale, and replaying historical tickets in bulk. These are accessible via natural language/MCP tooling. However, the evidence focuses on simulation/QA/knowledge-audit bulk operations rather than general-purpose bulk actions across arbitrary item types (e.g., bulk-editing many tickets, workflows, or records directly), and no independent hands-on confirmation of bulk throughput/scale exists. Missing for 10: evidence of bulk CRUD/action operations beyond simulations and audits, and independent verification of bulk operation reliability at scale.
